_note: Hand-written each season (Oct 29 2026). `season` = the season this file describes: when ggseason (the clock) moves on to a newer one, /call-of-duty-mobile/season hides `dates` + `groups` until this file is updated. Copy them from Activision's season post (`source`); `history` = ggseason's Season History list (UTC dates). New season: add the old one to the top of `history`, then replace the rest.
name: Vampires vs Werewolves

dates.name: Halloween Sale
dates.text: Discounts on the Grim Duo Draw, Hunger Eternal Draw, Night Creature Lucky Box, Bloody Vow Crate and a Halloween Series Armory bundle.

items.name: Leader's Kill Confirmed
items.text: Each team has one Leader, a mech-equipped Operator both teams can see. A Leader drops a dog tag worth far more, and the role passes to a teammate.

items.name: Attack of the Undead
items.text: On Haunted Hacienda and Haunted Standoff. Both maps also get their own 24/7 playlists at points in the season.

items.name: Fang Wars
items.text: Pick Vampires or Werewolves. Vampires earn the SO-14 — Moonlit, Werewolves the Type 25 — Lone Wolf. The winning side gets a Gold calling card.

items.name: Call of the Dead
items.text: Collect Howlbones for the event store. 100 of them unlock the K-9 Unit — Fantasma Operator Skill skin.

items.name: Grav
items.text: New assault rifle in the free tiers, with high bullet velocity.

items.name: Premium tiers
items.text: The player-voted Minotaur — Pack Commander and Sparrowhawk — Moonlight Vengeance, plus CX9 — Wolven Moonrise and 3-Line Rifle — Cantus Rubra.

items.name: Challenge Pass
items.text: Daily and weekly tasks for tokens. Rewards include the QXR — Rose Requiem.

items.name: Hunger Eternal
items.text: Legendary Grav — Vitae Devourer and Samael — The Soul Eater.

items.name: Weresoldier Unleashed
items.text: AK-117 — Lycan Eclipse and Bulldozer — Super Weresoldier.

items.name: Sapphire Winter
items.text: Einhorn Revolving — Cold-Blooded and Tempest — Sapphire.

items.name: Mythic re-runs
items.text: Whorl of Midnight (RAM-7 — Nebula's Brush) and Ultraviolet (AK-47 — Radiance).

items.name: Battle Pass Vaults
items.text: Shadows Return (S10 2021), To the Skies (S6 2022) and Orbital Raiders (S9 2024).

items.name: Early downloads
items.text: Download a season's update ahead of time in the in-game Download Manager.
